scope_text: Bounded synthetic profile only. The comparator applications (the OPA application and the LangGraph plus OPA application) are configured by Cognous, not vendor implementations. This is not independent certification and not production readiness; operational trust stays on HOLD. Linux only.
status: Declared interface of the OPA transactional application of the Wiki comparator. Each source reference is a file and line plus a marker text that the cited line must contain; comparators/tests/test_interface_declarations.py checks every reference. This file states what the application reads and offers. It is not a declaration of asked, not expressible or not claimed for any scenario: those declarations are in the plan file, each with a citation to an item of this file.

operations.execute: the only request operation (signed destination-command, issuer broker)

zero_argument_controls.unknown verb or argument: raises (AttributeError / KeyError); never a silent no-op

state.world: one deployed configuration: tools (14 named tools plus the 10 gateway tools gw_read_1..4, gw_write_1..3, gw_delete_1..2, gw_exec_1), agents (including gw-a1, gw-a2, gw-a3 whose allow-lists carry the per-tool rule of the gateway case), per-agent grants (grant-<agent>) and one grant of agent "agent" whose token carries the read scope only (grant-agent-ro), users, two delegation records (deleg-1 expires at 200, deleg-2 at 10000), budget hierarchy; the destination environment is prod until set_environment changes it; named from the Wiki case text

known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.non-ASCII text and non-integer numbers c: the shared wire/signature helper raises before any configuration sees the request (tested: test_shared_wire_format_limits_are_reported_not_worked_around); variants needing Unicode look-alikes, fractional amounts, NaN or infinity are unaskable
known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.clock above 999: the shared fixture keys expire at 1000, so windows longer than the key lifetime cannot be reset inside one scenario; the declared 3600-second windows are therefore only exercised within one window unless a plan chooses a shorter window length
known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.request has no field for the caller iden: carried only in issuer_claims, which the registered protected destination never reads (stated here for the comparator; the protected destination's own interface is declared separately)
known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.tool behaviour that changes with an iden: no field exposes behaviour; the application sees definitions only (TC-L06-008 variant "server-side behaviour only")
known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.alerts: an alert is recorded as an event field (threshold_alert) only; no delivery channel
known_absences_under_the_shared_fixture.several accepted effects with different: the scoring function compares the payload of every effect with the single expected_payload of the case; a scenario whose accepted effects go to different tools can only carry one payload when every tool accepts it: the four mock tools of the parameter-policy case share one parameter envelope for that reason (world_extensions/shared_parameter_envelope); any other tool with a closed schema does not

known_absences_in_this_application.mode switching and alerting of a failed: fail_open / fail_closed switch exists; the failure itself is not alerted anywhere (event only)
known_absences_in_this_application.approver context display: not modelled; approval records hold status, time and approver id only
known_absences_in_this_application.policy decision is OPA CLI per call: startup cost included in timing; no latency claim
known_absences_in_this_application.application controls: state mutation, approval records, window counters and idempotency are application code, not OPA guarantees

reason_vocabulary: comparator codes of this application; the Wiki plan omits expected_reasons (plan section 2), so no pass rests on them

exception_records.control: grant_exception:<agent>:<target>:<ttl> (record valid from the clock reading of the call to that reading plus ttl, expiry instant exclusive)
effect: opens a target outside the agent allow-list (TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED)
waives the absence of an approval on an approval-gated target (APPROVAL_PENDING)
never: does not open the targets of never_via_agent (ESCALATION_BLOCKED)
does not waive a recorded rejection, timeout or self-approval
does not change an operation, scope, user, delegation, budget or window rule

world_extensions._note: Items added to the declared world so that scenarios asked in the outcome files can be built. Each is small, is available to both comparator applications alike, and changes no expected outcome (comparators/DECISIONS.md C-11 to C-17). Source references are checked by comparators/tests/test_interface_declarations.py.

second_delegation_record.description: delegation record deleg-2: same scope as deleg-1 (user-a, read_file, data class public), expires at 10000; revoked only by revoke_delegation:deleg-2

budget_cap_control.description: set_budget:<level>:<id>:<cap> writes the cap of one existing budget record (usage kept); unknown level or id raises KeyError, a cap that is not a non-negative integer raises ValueError

allow_list_removal_control.description: disallow_tool:<agent>:<tool> removes a tool from the allow-list of one agent (and from its read class); a tool that is not on the list raises KeyError

read_only_token_grant.description: grant-agent-ro: a grant of agent "agent" (environment prod, valid to 10000) whose token scopes are read:tickets only

destination_environment_control.description: set_environment:<prod|non-prod> sets the environment of the destination (default prod); any other value raises KeyError

task_tool_claim.description: issuer claim task_tools (list of strings): the tools that the user's request requires; a call to another tool is denied (TASK_TOOL_NOT_WARRANTED, family task_scope); an empty list means no tool is warranted; no claim means no task limit; a value that is not a list of strings is CLAIMS_INVALID

shared_parameter_envelope.description: send_email, transfer_test_funds, read_file and update_records share one parameter envelope (recipient, body, amount, account, path, records): each requires its own parameter, the others are optional keys checked by type and by the parameter rules; a key outside the envelope is an unknown argument (SCHEMA_VIOLATION)
